requirements.quote:
A CRYPTO frame (type=0x06) is used to transmit cryptographic
   handshake messages.  It can be sent in all packet types except 0-RTT.
requirements.condition: When encoding or recognizing a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame type can be inspected and compared with the fixed value 0x06.

requirements.quote:
A CRYPTO frame (type=0x06) is used to transmit cryptographic
   handshake messages.  It can be sent in all packet types except 0-RTT.
requirements.condition: When selecting a packet type in which to send a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send a CRYPTO frame in a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Generated packets can be inspected to determine whether a 0-RTT packet contains a CRYPTO frame.

requirements.quote:
The CRYPTO frame offers the cryptographic protocol an in-order stream
   of bytes.  CRYPTO frames are functionally identical to STREAM frames,
   except that they do not bear a stream identifier; they are not flow
   controlled; and they do not carry markers for optional offset,
   optional length, and the end of the stream.
requirements.condition: When CRYPTO data arrives across CRYPTO frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Expose the cryptographic protocol to an in-order stream of bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can deliver CRYPTO frames out of offset order and verify that bytes are exposed to the cryptographic protocol in offset order.

requirements.quote:
The CRYPTO frame offers the cryptographic protocol an in-order stream
   of bytes.  CRYPTO frames are functionally identical to STREAM frames,
   except that they do not bear a stream identifier; they are not flow
   controlled; and they do not carry markers for optional offset,
   optional length, and the end of the stream.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include a stream identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame encoding and parser model can be inspected for the absence of a stream identifier field.

requirements.quote:
The CRYPTO frame offers the cryptographic protocol an in-order stream
   of bytes.  CRYPTO frames are functionally identical to STREAM frames,
   except that they do not bear a stream identifier; they are not flow
   controlled; and they do not carry markers for optional offset,
   optional length, and the end of the stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply stream flow control to CRYPTO frames.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be tested to verify that STREAM flow-control limits do not gate CRYPTO-frame transmission or acceptance.

requirements.quote:
The CRYPTO frame offers the cryptographic protocol an in-order stream
   of bytes.  CRYPTO frames are functionally identical to STREAM frames,
   except that they do not bear a stream identifier; they are not flow
   controlled; and they do not carry markers for optional offset,
   optional length, and the end of the stream.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include markers that make the Offset field, Length field, or end-of-stream indication optional.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame layout and parser can be inspected to confirm the absence of optional-offset, optional-length, and end-of-stream marker bits.

requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the frame fields in order as Type, Offset, Length, and Crypto Data.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized field sequence can be inspected against the specified layout.

requirements.quote:
Offset:  A variable-length integer specifying the byte offset in the
      stream for the data in this CRYPTO frame.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing the Offset field of a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and interpret Offset as a variable-length integer specifying the byte offset of this frame's data in its CRYPTO stream.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoding type and its use in positioning Crypto Data can be tested directly.

requirements.quote:
Length:  A variable-length integer specifying the length of the
      Crypto Data field in this CRYPTO frame.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing the Length field of a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode Length as a variable-length integer whose value equals the length of the Crypto Data field.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can decode Length and compare it with the number of bytes in Crypto Data.

requirements.quote:
There is a separate flow of cryptographic handshake data in each
   encryption level, each of which starts at an offset of 0.  This
   implies that each encryption level is treated as a separate CRYPTO
   stream of data.
requirements.condition: For each encryption level carrying cryptographic handshake data.
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain a separate CRYPTO data stream for that encryption level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not combine offset spaces or handshake-data flows across encryption levels.
requirements.why_checkable: Frames at different encryption levels can be supplied with overlapping offsets and the implementation's reassembly state can be checked for separation.

requirements.quote:
There is a separate flow of cryptographic handshake data in each
   encryption level, each of which starts at an offset of 0.  This
   implies that each encryption level is treated as a separate CRYPTO
   stream of data.
requirements.condition: When initializing the CRYPTO stream for an encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Start that encryption level's CRYPTO offset space at 0.
requirements.why_checkable: The first byte position and reassembly state for every encryption level can be checked against offset 0.

requirements.quote:
The largest offset delivered on a stream -- the sum of the offset and
   data length -- cannot exceed 2^62-1.  Receipt of a frame that exceeds
   this limit MUST be treated as a connection error of type
   FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR or CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED.
requirements.required_behavior: Ensure that the sum of the frame Offset and Crypto Data length does not exceed 2^62-1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not deliver or accept a largest stream offset greater than 2^62-1.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can compute Offset plus data length and compare the result with the fixed upper bound.

requirements.quote:
The largest offset delivered on a stream -- the sum of the offset and
   data length -- cannot exceed 2^62-1.  Receipt of a frame that exceeds
   this limit MUST be treated as a connection error of type
   FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR or CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED.
requirements.condition: Upon receipt of a CRYPTO frame whose Offset plus Crypto Data length exceeds 2^62-1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue processing the frame as valid.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the condition as a connection error of type FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR or CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED.
requirements.why_checkable: A boundary-crossing frame can be injected and the resulting connection error code can be observed.

requirements.quote:
Unlike STREAM frames, which include a stream ID indicating to which
   stream the data belongs, the CRYPTO frame carries data for a single
   stream per encryption level.  The stream does not have an explicit
   end, so CRYPTO frames do not have a FIN bit.
requirements.condition: When associating CRYPTO-frame data at an encryption level.
requirements.required_behavior: Associate the data with the single CRYPTO stream for that encryption level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not select among multiple CRYPTO streams within one encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation state and frame processing can be checked to confirm exactly one CRYPTO stream context per encryption level.

requirements.quote:
Unlike STREAM frames, which include a stream ID indicating to which
   stream the data belongs, the CRYPTO frame carries data for a single
   stream per encryption level.  The stream does not have an explicit
   end, so CRYPTO frames do not have a FIN bit.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include or process a FIN bit or other explicit end marker in a CRYPTO frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame and parser can be inspected for the absence of a FIN bit and explicit stream-end state.
